description: Reference example for Renovate server maintainers: keep a UBI 9 base image pinned by tag and digest up to date. One pull request moves the tag and digest together, for a new minor (9.8 to 9.9) or for a rebuild of the same tag, which Red Hat publishes for security fixes under a new digest. Stays within UBI 9: UBI 10 is another image name, a decision rather than an update. Copy and adapt the file patterns and key names to your repositories.

customManagers.description: A base image override, BASE_IMAGE=<image>:<tag>@sha256:<digest>, in CI configuration, scripts or properties: a registry mirror or another base image passed with --build-arg. Not the Dockerfile, whose plugin-managed block each plugin release rewrites.

A tag and digest kept as separate, adjacent values, as in a version catalogue: ubi-minimal-tag = "9.8" then ubi-minimal-digest = "sha256:…". Rename the keys and the file pattern for your own catalogue.

packageRules.description: Plain 9.<minor> tags only: Red Hat also publishes 9.<minor>-<build> tags and latest.
The ARG BASE_IMAGE default in a java-app or node-app Dockerfile belongs to the plugin, which rewrites it from each release; update the plugin instead.
